meta.title: Revised Lba Cra And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of May 7, 2024; May 21, 2024; June 4, 2024; and June 11, 2024 (LBA)
votes.description: The Local Building Authority Board approved its meeting minutes from four prior meetings in 2024.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 01 of 2025, adopting the tentative budget for the Capital Projects Fund of the Local Building Authority of Salt Lake City, Utah for Fiscal Year 2025-26
votes.description: The LBA Board adopted its tentative FY2025-26 Capital Projects Fund budget, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Local Building Authority and convene as the Community Reinvestment Agency
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the LBA meeting and transition to the CRA meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 07 of 2025, adopting the tentative budget for the Community Reinvestment Agency of Salt Lake City, Utah for Fiscal Year 2025-26
votes.description: The CRA Board adopted its tentative FY2025-26 budget for the Community Reinvestment Agency of Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Community Reinvestment Agency and convene as the City Council
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the CRA meeting and transition to the City Council meeting.

votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of February 18, 2025; March 4, 2025; and April 15, 2025, as well as the formal meeting minutes of March 25, 2025 and April 15, 2025
votes.description: The City Council approved minutes from three work sessions and two formal meetings held earlier in 2025.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on the Mixed-Use (MU) Zoning Consolidation Zoning Text and Map Amendment to a future Council meeting
votes.description: The Council continued the public hearing on the proposed consolidation of up to 27 existing zoning districts into six new mixed-use districts to allow additional time to address public feedback.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 26 of 2025, vacating a City-owned alley between approximately 2615 South and 2700 South, and between Beverly Street and Chadwick Streets
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and approved the vacation of a City-owned alley near 2680 South Chadwick Street, with the alley property to be divided among abutting property owners.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 27 of 2025, Budget Amendment No. 5 for all items except Council-added items I-2 (contribution to Mead Avenue underpass) and I-3 (contribution to Art in District 4), and defer action on Items I-2 and I-3 to a future Council Meeting
votes.description: The Council adopted FY2024-25 Budget Amendment No. 5, covering items such as the 400 South Bridge Reconstruction and Hive Pass funding, while deferring two Council-added items to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action for Item G-4 (Grant Application: Financial Empowerment Center Academy) to a future Consent Agenda
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the Financial Empowerment Center Academy grant application and deferred final action to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 28 of 2025, vacating a portion of City-owned alley adjacent to properties at approximately 1409 South Edison Street and 1404 South 200 East
votes.description: The Council approved the vacation of a portion of City-owned alley near 1409 South Edison Street, with the property to be transferred to abutting owners despite a negative Planning Commission recommendation.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 25 of 2025, approving City Flag designs and standards for display of a City Flag
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance establishing official City Flag designs and display standards, including Pride and Juneteenth flags, as symbols of the city's diversity and inclusivity.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 12 of 2025, adopting the tentative budget for Salt Lake City, Utah, including the tentative budget of the Library Fund, for Fiscal Year 2025-26
votes.description: The Council adopted the tentative FY2025-26 budget for Salt Lake City and the Library Fund, initiating the formal budget process ahead of public hearings and final adoption.

The Council approved the consent agenda, which included setting a public hearing date for Library Budget Amendment No. 2 and approving board appointments to the Transportation Advisory Board, Racial Equity in Policing Commission, and Bicycle Advisory Committee.
